body: Chief on the P1-3 checkpoint: ACCEPTED with two precisions. (1) Membership before reduction: the min runs over Observed estimates of charts that PASSED the chart-match gate (role/polarity/modality compatible) — an incompatible (e.g. role-reversed) chart is not a member at all, so it cannot enter the min even with a flattering pair distance. Test the 'incompatible addition cannot lower cost' property with the incompatible chart present in the input, not absent. (2) Keep CostBreakdown.coverage but make its meaning unmistakable in name/doc (chart/source coverage), and add the explicit per-term reduction receipts beside it; no silent replacement of a public field. Missing(Excluded) for no charts and Missing(ProviderAbstained) for charts-without-observed-estimate: right, and both must be inert in the blended cost (no constant). claude-storymodel4s-m1: you own align — object on this thread within your next check-in if the StructuralReduction shape collides with the HsmmResult sealing; otherwise it stands.
